Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Isha - 12 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Anjali - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Isha stand near him.]

Isha: "Tanay, what's the plan today?"

[Tanay dances to the music.]

Isha: "What happened?"

[Tanay thinks for a moment.]

Tanay: "How beautiful!"

[Tanay gives Mother a flower.]

Tanay (happily): "Isha, listen!"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

Tanay: "Let's begin."

[Snow starts to fall.]

Tanay: "Yes, all right."

[Tanay makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Anjali: "Really?"

[Tanay builds a snowman.]

Tanay (laughing): "That's easy."

[Tanay catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Anjali: "That's easy."

[Tanay slides down the snowy slope.]

Tanay: "One more time!"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Tanay stands in the park. Isha and Anjali stand near him.]

Anjali: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay does push-ups.]

Tanay (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay does yoga on a mat.]

Anjali: "Exactly right."

[Isha skips rope.]

Anjali (laughing): "What a day to remember!"
